newsitem.title: HONG KONG: TNT/BA in talks to link Euro/Asian networks.
newsitem.headline: TNT/BA in talks to link Euro/Asian networks.

text.p: TNT Express Worldwide (HK) Ltd said it is negotiating with British Airways to link its overnight express network in Asia with cities across Europe, TNT's general manager in Hong Kong, Bryan Chan, told Reuters.

Chan said TNT hopes to utilise British Airways' extensive scheduled services throughout Europe to offer a new, guaranteed, same day service to more than 10 major European cities connecting TNT's Asian Air Express and Euro 1 networks. British Airways already carries TNT traffic but only to London.
Chan said he hopes an announcement can be made within the next three months.
If successful, the proposed premium service, which has yet to be named, would mean a substantial improvement in customer service, Chan said.

"We want our service to be further improved not only covering London. If it goes ahead, we would be the first to offer a same day service from Asia. We have already identified the possible city connections across Europe and British Airways is a likely potential partner," Chan said.

Because of high customer demand, the proposed link would first start on British Airways flights from Hong Kong with other Asian destinations served by the UK flag carrier possibly being included later, Chan added.
